import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv', parse_dates=['date'])
a = df[df.account_id=='tVENWJP']
before = a[(a.date>='2025-09-01')&(a.date<='2025-09-21')]
after = a[(a.date>='2025-09-22')&(a.date<='2025-10-15')]
# compare per row-key averages
key=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
b = before.groupby(key)['unblended_cost'].sum()/before.date.nunique()
af = after.groupby(key)['unblended_cost'].sum()/after.date.nunique()
cmp = pd.concat([b.rename('before'), af.rename('after')], axis=1).fillna(0)
cmp['diff']=cmp.after-cmp.before
print(cmp.sort_values('diff', ascending=False).head(20))
